title: The essential image of closed direct image
statement:
For a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ that is quasi-compact as a morphism, a pro-etale module sheaf $F$ lies in the image of $i_*$ if
and only if $j^*F=0$. For such a sheaf the canonical unit $F\to i_*i^*F$ is
an isomorphism. Here the coefficient convention is that of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]: fix a sheaf $A_X$ of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, sheaves $A_Z,A_U$ on $Z_{\mathrm{proet}},U_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and isomorphisms $c_i:i^{-1}A_X\xrightarrow{\sim}A_Z$, $c_j:j^{-1}A_X\xrightarrow{\sim}A_U$. The functors $i^*,i_*,j^*$ use these identifications, and $F$ is any $A_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Being in the image means being isomorphic to $i_*G$ for some $A_Z$-module sheaf $G$.

proof.text: Transport coefficients using the scalar equivalence of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations. Restriction along ci identifies its functor followed by ringed direct image with the specified direct image: the sectionwise identity linear maps give a natural isomorphism coefficientDirectImageIso. Tensor extension along cj is naturally isomorphic to the inverse scalar equivalence by uniqueness of left adjoints (proEtaleRingExtensionAdjunction). Hence pullback vanishes if and only if module inverse image vanishes. These constructions use no chosen module data.

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed to the object V = ProEt.mk j. Its equivalence q and inverse-image comparison identify zero open inverse image with zero localized restriction. Retain its closed adjunction ai, open adjunction aj, zero open restriction of closed direct images, invertible closed counit, and canonical localization sequence. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness of X is needed.

proof.text: For F isomorphic to the specified i_*G, coefficientDirectImageIso identifies it with the ringed direct image of the scalar transport of G. Apply the localized open restriction to this isomorphism and use the vanishing provided in the preceding step. The scalar and localized-site equivalences then imply j^*F is zero.

proof.text: If j^*F is zero, localized open restriction is zero. Since extension by zero is left adjoint, it preserves zero objects. In the canonical localization sequence the left term is therefore zero. Convert ComposableArrows.Exact to the short-complex exactness predicate; Exact.mono_g applied to the zero first map makes ai.unit.app F monic. The localization sequence also makes it epic, so it is invertible in the abelian module-sheaf category. Transport ai.left.obj F back through the inverse coefficient equivalence; coefficientDirectImageIso, the equivalence counit, and the inverse unit compose to an explicit essential-image witness for the specified i_*.

proof.text: To establish invertibility of the actual tensor-unit-normalized unit, use the invertible counit supplied by the same ringed localization theorem to obtain full faithfulness of ringed closed direct image (Mathlib Adjunction.fullyFaithfulROfIsIsoCounit). Full faithfulness is preserved by composition with the scalar equivalence and by coefficientDirectImageIso, so the specified i_* is fully faithful. Mathlib Adjunction.isIso_unit_app_iff_mem_essImage, applied to proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction itself and the essential-image witness just constructed, proves invertibility of precisely its unit. This avoids a separate explicit comparison of the two unit formulas.
